text: No, the June 2025 due-diligence statement is no longer valid. New evidence from 2026 shows a **13.5-hectare tree-cover loss event in 2025** (3.9% of the asset), corroborated by both Hansen GFC and JRC 2020 data. The 2025 report (run-1) did not detect this loss because it only analyzed data up to 2024. The 2026 update (run-2) includes the 2025 Hansen GFC data, which confirms the loss. The asset’s forest cover remains largely intact (65.7% as of 2020), but the 2025 loss must now be accounted for.
